reading.title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Education
reading.passage: Artificial intelligence is revolutionizing the education sector by personalizing learning experiences for students. AI-powered platforms can analyze student performance data and adapt teaching methods to match individual learning styles. Teachers can use AI tools to automate administrative tasks, allowing them to focus more on interactive instruction. However, concerns about data privacy and reduced human interaction remain important considerations. Educational institutions must balance technological innovation with maintaining meaningful student-teacher relationships.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one benefit of AI in education?
options: It eliminates the need for teachers
It personalizes learning experiences for students
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'AI-powered platforms can analyze student performance data and adapt teaching methods to match individual learning styles'라고 명시되어 있습니다. AI는 학생의 학습 스타일에 맞게 교육 방식을 개인화합니다.

questions.q: What concern does the passage mention about AI in education?
options: Data privacy and reduced human interaction
questions.explanation: 'However, concerns about data privacy and reduced human interaction remain important considerations'라는 문장에서 주요 우려 사항이 명확하게 언급되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the passage suggest educational institutions should do?
options: Balance technological innovation with meaningful relationships
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장 'Educational institutions must balance technological innovation with maintaining meaningful student-teacher relationships'에서 기관들이 기술혁신과 인간관계의 균형을 맞춰야 한다고 제시합니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology should replace traditional teaching methods in schools'? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 제시: 동의하거나 동의하지 않는 입장을 분명히 밝히고, 1-2개의 주요 이유를 간단히 소개합니다.
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유: 구체적인 예시와 함께 기술의 장점(개인맞춤 학습, 접근성 향상) 또는 단점(인간관계 약화, 기술격차)을 설명합니다.
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유: 교육의 다양한 측면을 고려합니다. 예를 들어 학생의 사회성 발달, 비판적 사고력 개발, 또는 기술의 효율성 등을 논의합니다.
structure.conclusion: 핵심 주장을 재강조하고, 균형잡힌 접근(기술과 전통 방식의 조화)이 가장 효과적일 수 있음을 시사합니다.

useful_phrases: In my opinion, technology should not completely replace traditional teaching because...
Furthermore, students need face-to-face interaction for social development...
For example, online platforms can personalize learning, but teachers provide...
In conclusion, the most effective approach would be to combine both methods...

speaking.prompt: Some people believe that learning through online platforms is more effective than traditional classroom learning. Others prefer traditional classroom learning. Which approach do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer... because...
sample_points: 전통 교실 학습의 장점: 교사와의 직접적인 상호작용, 또래 학생들과의 협력 학습, 실시간 질문 가능, 학습 규율 유지
온라인 학습의 장점: 시간과 장소의 자유로움, 개인맞춤 학습 속도, 반복 학습 가능, 다양한 학습 자료 접근

listening.title: 대학 상담 - 전공 선택에 대한 조언
listening.script: Student: 'Professor, I'm having trouble deciding between engineering and business. I enjoy problem-solving, but I also care about working with people.' Professor: 'Those are both valuable skills. In engineering, you'll focus on technical problem-solving, but modern engineering also requires strong teamwork. In business, you'll work with diverse teams daily, though you'll still need analytical skills. Many students find that internships help clarify their interests. Have you considered interning in either field?' Student: 'That's a great idea. I hadn't thought about that.' Professor: 'You could also take electives from both fields this semester to get a better sense of what resonates with you. The choice doesn't have to be final immediately; many students explore both before deciding.'

questions.q: What is the main topic of this conversation?
options: Advice on choosing between engineering and business majors
questions.explanation: 학생이 공학과 경영학 사이에서 전공 선택에 어려움을 겪고 있고, 교수가 이에 대한 조언을 제공하는 것이 주요 내용입니다.

questions.q: What does the professor suggest the student should do? (Select all that apply)
options: Avoid working with teams in either field
questions.explanation: 교수는 인턴십 경험을 통해 관심 분야를 명확히 할 수 있다고 제안하며, 동시에 두 분야의 선택과목을 수강할 것을 권장합니다.

questions.q: According to the professor, what skill is needed in both engineering and business?
questions.explanation: 교수는 '현대 공학도 강력한 팀워크가 필요하고' 비즈니스는 '다양한 팀과 함께 일한다'고 언급하여 두 분야 모두 팀워크가 중요함을 강조합니다.
